subject.title: feat(agents): opt-in self-evolving SOUL.md via reflection sub-turn + soul_update

question: Should OpenClaw core permit an opt-in model sub-turn to persist new bootstrap instructions into SOUL.md, and if so what authorization, notification, and recovery contract must every ingress satisfy?
rationale: The patch creates a new configuration, CLI, tool, persistent-instruction, latency, and security boundary; code review cannot determine whether that core product contract is intended or whether the capability should be narrowed or live outside core.

options.title: Sponsor a hardened core feature
options.body: Approve the direction only after the implementation uses a private capability, runs after turn admission, notifies the originating channel, contains failures, and proves upgrade behavior.

options.title: Narrow the core surface
options.body: Keep SOUL.md persistence user-driven or CLI-driven and omit automatic model-triggered mutation from normal conversation ingress.

options.title: Decline automatic persistence
options.body: Close the implementation direction and retain the current explicit/manual SOUL.md editing contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a hardened core feature
recommendation.body: Approve the direction only after the implementation uses a private capability, runs after turn admission, notifies the originating channel, contains failures, and proves upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent major ownership of the central agent-runtime path makes this the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
